topic: how gecko toe structures create dry adhesion

continuity_bible.subject_identity: the same tokay gecko with blue-gray skin, orange spots, intact toes, and anatomically consistent feet
continuity_bible.environment: one charcoal macro-science set built around the same vertical glass panel
continuity_bible.lighting: soft cool key from upper left and narrow amber rim from camera right
continuity_bible.color_treatment: photoreal blue-gray gecko, charcoal glass, restrained cyan microscopy accents
continuity_bible.screen_direction: the gecko and magnified contact sequence progress bottom-left to top-right
continuity_bible.camera_language: natural wildlife macro joined to precise microscopy scale transitions

factual_notes.claim: Gecko adhesive toe pads contain microscopic setae that branch into smaller contacts.
factual_notes.source_title: Evidence for van der Waals adhesion in gecko setae

factual_notes.claim: The many close contacts generate dry adhesion without liquid glue.

script_segments.narration: This gecko can sprint up glass without glue, suction, or sticky liquid.
script_segments.caption: NO GLUE. NO SUCTION.
script_segments.visual_action: The gecko takes three clearly visible steps straight up clean glass
script_segments.entry_action: Open on a planted rear foot as the front foot lifts
script_segments.exit_action: End when one front toe pad contacts the glass
script_segments.ambience: One continuous location ambience and restrained cinematic music bed

script_segments.narration: The secret begins under each wide toe, where ridges divide into dense microscopic hairs.
script_segments.caption: MILLIONS OF TINY CONTACTS
script_segments.visual_action: A motivated match move enters the same front toe and reveals dense branching setae
script_segments.entry_action: Continue through the contacting toe pad
script_segments.ambience: One continuous location ambience and restrained cinematic music bed

script_segments.narration: Each hair branches again, creating enormous contact with the surface at tiny scales.
script_segments.caption: CONTACT AT TINY SCALES
script_segments.visual_action: One seta branches into spatula-shaped tips meeting the glass
script_segments.ambience: One continuous location ambience and restrained cinematic music bed

script_segments.narration: At that distance, weak molecular attractions add up across the whole foot.
script_segments.caption: WEAK FORCES ADD UP
script_segments.visual_action: Restrained cyan force lines appear only at touching tips and spread across the planted foot
script_segments.exit_action: Force pattern resolves into the full toe silhouette
script_segments.ambience: One continuous location ambience and restrained cinematic music bed

script_segments.narration: To let go, the gecko changes the angle of its toes and peels them away.
script_segments.caption: ANGLE TO RELEASE
script_segments.visual_action: The same toe hyperextends and peels cleanly from glass in one natural action
script_segments.entry_action: Enter on the resolved toe silhouette
script_segments.exit_action: Finish as the foot swings upward
script_segments.ambience: One continuous location ambience and restrained cinematic music bed

script_segments.narration: So the grip is powerful, reversible, and dry: geometry turns tiny forces into a climbing system.
script_segments.caption: GEOMETRY BECOMES GRIP
script_segments.visual_action: Return to the same gecko completing the climb and pausing above the glass edge
script_segments.exit_action: Hold the gecko safely perched for half a second
script_segments.ambience: One continuous location ambience and restrained cinematic music bed
